bio: Urban Meadow is a stunning, light venue located near Kensington Palace, bringing to life the wilderness and raw beauty of a Hyde Park (meadow) set against a sophisticated, London (urban) backdrop, with a beautiful terrace for al fresco dining.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Urban Meadow Cafe where you can enjoy a  selection of finger sandwiches, freshly baked scone served with  strawberry jam and clotted cream, a selection of cakes and a pot of  tea.  Gluten Free Afternoon Tea is available upon request.
